exercises.question: Which sentence contains a relative clause?
options: El río, que atraviesa la ciudad, necesita protección. [The river, which crosses the city, needs protection.]
El río atraviesa la ciudad y necesita protección. [The river crosses the city and needs protection.]
Hay un bosque cerca del río y cerca del pueblo. [There is a forest near the river and near the village.]

exercises.sentence: El bosque __ está cerca del pueblo es muy tranquilo.
exercises.english: The forest that is near the village is very peaceful.
There are species that live in this area.

sentences: Primero, describimos el bosque. [First, we describe the forest.]
Después, describimos el río. [Then we describe the river.]
Finalmente, describimos las especies. [Finally, we describe the species.]

exercises.question: Which word introduces a place relative clause?
options: donde [where]
porque [because]
aunque [although]

exercises.sentence: Es un lugar __ muchas personas pasean.
exercises.english: It is a place where many people go for walks.
The river that crosses the city needs protection.

exercises.sentence: El bosque que está cerca del pueblo es muy tranquilo.
options: The forest that is near the village is very peaceful.
The river that is near the village is very noisy.
The forest that is near the village has disappeared.

exercises.sentence: Hay especies que viven en esta zona.
options: There are species that live in this area.
There are no species in this area.
The species live in another country.

exercises.sentence: Es un lugar donde muchas personas pasean.
exercises.english: It is a place where many people go for walks.

options: Es un bosque que está cerca del pueblo. [It is a forest that is near the village.]
Es un bosque donde está cerca del pueblo. [It is a forest where is near the village.]
Es un bosque que esté cerca del pueblo. [It is a forest that be (subjunctive) near the village.]
Hay especies que viven en esta zona. [There are species that live in this area.]
Hay especies que vivan en esta zona. [There are species that live (subjunctive) in this area.]
Hay especies donde viven en esta zona. [There are species where live in this area.]
En un lugar donde hay muchos árboles. [In a place where there are many trees.]
En un lugar que hay muchos árboles. [In a place that there are many trees.]
En un lugar donde hayan muchos árboles. [In a place where there be (plural) many trees.]

template.prompt: Describe a natural place using a relative clause.
template.answer: Es un bosque que está cerca del pueblo y donde viven muchas especies.

template.prompt: Describe a river, forest or other natural place.
template.answer: El río que atraviesa la ciudad es importante porque proporciona agua a muchas personas.
